title: PCSK9 inhibitor
notice: Fictional exercise criteria. Not a payer policy, prescribing guide, or clinical recommendation. Draft for pharmacist review. Modeled on common documentation patterns, without reproducing a real policy.
request_date_rule: Use the provider letter or form request date. Conflicting source dates require review. A numeric date that can be read two ways is settled only by a day above 12 elsewhere on the page or by a later fax-style received date. Otherwise it requires review.
logic: All five criteria require evidence. Missing evidence is not a denial. Contradiction, unclear duration, unconfirmed diagnosis, unreadable evidence and ambiguous dates require review.

criteria.text: Established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease is documented as the reason for this request. A condition found only in a history or problem list, a suspected diagnosis, or a different requested indication does not meet this rule.
LDL-C is at least 70 mg/dL, measured within 180 days before the request.

A high-intensity statin, atorvastatin 40 or 80 mg or rosuvastatin 20 or 40 mg daily, for at least 90 days, with LDL-C on or before the start and at least 90 days after the start that is still 70 mg/dL or higher. A documented statin intolerance or contraindication, with its reason, also meets this rule.
The requested evolocumab dose is 140 mg every 2 weeks.
